item.title: Valuation Reveals Uncertainty
item.description: arXiv:2606.29572v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: This paper studies the recovery of uncertainty from dynamic sublinear valuation rules. Robust valuation assigns each payoff its worst-case expected value over a family of plausible models, thereby inducing a dynamic sublinear valuation rule. While valuation rules are observable in practice, the underlying uncertainty structure remains latent. Under suitable conditions, we show that an uncertainty structure can be recovered from an observed valuation rule and provide an explicit recovery procedure. The construction characterizes the joint uncertainty in the discount factor and the law of the state process.
item.dc:creator: Jongjin Park, David Criens, Hyungbin Park
